thread:
vivian: quick check on required-field UX for the new pipeline form. Thoughts on an inline microlabel 'Required' vs an indicator glyph + focus-reveal? we need something that survives zoom and high-contrast modes
greg: glyph + focus-reveal is nice for density. my worry: invisible to keyboard-only users unless the reveal is keyboard-accessible. also: where to put the helper reason when a field is conditionally required?
samir: proposal: always render a compact visual indicator (CSS ::after), but include a focusable button next to the label that reveals a short overlay saying 'Required' and optional reason. overlay must be reachable via keyboard and surfaced to SRs via aria-describedby
paula_a11y: a11y checklist: 1) aria-required on the input control 2) if reveal has explanatory text, ensure aria-describedby includes that element id 3) no layout shift when reveal appears (use absolute overlay) 4) do not use placeholder for required state
vivian: good. also we need an implementation-friendly variant for mobile: show glyph only, with reveal on focus if screen width > 480px or when the field receives keyboard focus
greg: dev note: use a design token for the indicator color so QA can validate contrast across themes. avoid color-only signals

vivian: deletion flow: current modal is just 'Delete pipeline' + checkbox 'I understand'. feedback? typed confirm vs checkbox?
paula_a11y: typed confirm reduces accidents but creates friction for screen reader users who have motor difficulties. If we require typed confirm, we must provide an accessible alternative (consult research) and ensure ARIA live announcements for errors
samir: let's do risk-tiered confirmations: 1) low-risk (small test pipelines) -> destructive CTA + undo toast 2) medium-risk -> checkbox + explicit consequences listed 3) high-risk (prod flagged or >X runs) -> typed confirm + list of linked resources. server should return `confirm_level` so client shows appropriate modal
greg: agree on server-driven gating. also include a short consequences summary (linked dashboards, scheduled jobs) collapsed by default with a 'More info' link

vivian: error handling pattern: inline field errors below the control for single-field failures; floating top banner (role=alert) with anchors when errors are cross-field or >2. anchors should focus the target field
paula_a11y: ensure aria-invalid is set on invalid inputs and that the top banner announces count on open. auto-focus first invalid field on submit

samir: i'll mock compact+expanded variants and include an acceptance checklist: aria-required, aria-describedby for reveals, no layout shift, server-driven confirm_level, undo toast behavior, aria-live for typed-confirm errors, focus-first-invalid. will post in this thread by EOD :spiral_note_pad:
